title: St Mary's Chapel at Glastonbury Abbey keeps the original chapel's diameter

tellings.quote: Mary's Chapel. Its width of 39.6 6 feet it is said preserves the diameter of the original chapel.

plain: St Mary's Chapel at Glastonbury Abbey in England is 39.6 feet wide, and that width is said to preserve the diameter of the original chapel that stood there. A researcher named Randall Carlson tells Michels this as something "it is said", without naming a source, as part of his interest in measurements carried down from ancient times.
